title: Use logical directions for range, meter, and progress orientation

labels.name: i18n-tracker
labels.description: Group bringing to attention of Internationalization, or tracked by i18n but not needing response.

body:
The orientation of these controls was described in physical terms. For 'sideways-lr', whose inline direction runs from bottom to top, that put the lowest value of a range control, the minimum value of a meter, and the start of a progress bar on the top rather than on the inline-start side. Chromium and WebKit put all of them on the inline-start side, as does Gecko for range controls. The illustration for the progress element also had its vertical progress bars the wrong way around. This is a follow-up to 702119c9ede1655dca3d32b4b18111f24a91ccbc. - [ ] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed): * WebKit * Chromium presumably? - [x] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at: * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/63544 * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/65375 - [ ] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed: * Chromium: https://crbug.com/1005518 * Gecko: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2094651 * WebKit: https://webkit.org/b/164507 & https://webkit.org/b/214291 - [x] Corresponding [HTML AAM](https://w3c.github.io/html-aam/) & [ARIA in HTML](https://w3c.github.io/html-aria/) issues & PRs: N/A - [x] [MDN issue](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) is filed: N/A - [x] The top of this comment includes a [clear commit message](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/COMMITTING.md) to use. (See [WHATWG Working Mode: Changes](https://whatwg.org/working-mode#changes) for more details.) *** ### :boom: Error: Wattsi server error :boom: ### [PR Preview](https://github.com/specinfra/pr-preview#pr-preview) failed to build. _(Last tried on Nov 18, 2026, 2:58 PM UTC)_.
More PR Preview relies on a number of web services to run. There seems to be an issue with the following one: :rotating_light: [Wattsi Server](https://github.com/domenic/wattsi-server) - Wattsi Server is the web service used to build the WHATWG HTML spec. :link: [Related URL](https://build.whatwg.org/wattsi) **Error output:** ```

Error code: 503

Well, This is unexpected. An Error has occurred, and we are working to fix the problem! We will be up and running shortly. Try refreshing the page or try again in a few minutes.

upstream_reset_before_response_started{connection_termination} (503 UC)

App Platform failed to forward this request to the application.

``` _This seems to be an issue with the [Wattsi Server](https://github.com/domenic/wattsi-server) service. PR Preview doesn't manage this service and so has no control over it. If you've identified an issue with it, you can [report the issue to the maintainers of Wattsi Server](https://github.com/domenic/wattsi-server/issues/new) directly. Please be courteous. Thank you!_ _If you don't have enough information above to solve the error by yourself or if the issue doesn't seem related to Wattsi Server, you can [file an issue with PR Preview](https://github.com/specinfra/pr-preview/issues/new?title=Unidentified%20Error&body=See%20whatwg/html%2313054.)._
